in_marathi.name: Siddhikaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Achiever of spiritual goals
in_marathi.long_meaning: Siddhikaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Siddhikaa is a feminine name of Sanskrit origin. It signifies one who has accomplished her spiritual goals and is on the path to enlightenment.
